decision: backfill to reality — the single RwLock<Pool> implementation is the intended, working design; the 16-way sharded + Creusot-verified design in earlier spec revisions was never built.

proposals.rationale: Spec mandated a 16-way sharded pool; src/lib.rs:76-85,313-316 holds one FreeList + one HashMap behind a single RwLock<Pool>. No Shard struct, NUM_SHARDS, or shard_for_key exists. Code is the intended reality.
proposals.before: Pool is divided into 16 independent shards
proposals.after: Pool state (allocator + slot map) is held as a single, unsharded structure behind one `RwLock<Pool>` (no shards)

proposals.rationale: No key-modulo-16 shard selection exists (src/lib.rs). The real concurrency mechanism is a single reader-writer lock; rewrote FR-006 to describe it instead of the non-existent shard selection.
proposals.before: Shard selection uses key modulo 16 (Verified: Creusot P4, P5)
proposals.after: Concurrency uses one reader-writer lock: read operations (get, peek, contains, batch_touch, capacity, used) take a shared read lock; mutations (insert, remove, evict, clear) take an exclusive write lock (Verified: Implementation)

proposals.rationale: One allocator + slot map under a single RwLock (src/lib.rs:76-79), not per-shard Mutex-protected structures.
proposals.before: Each shard has its own Mutex-protected allocator and slot map
proposals.after: A single first-fit `FreeList` allocator and a single `HashMap<CacheKey, Slot>` slot map serve the whole pool

proposals.rationale: evict_next delegates to ep.identify_next_to_evict(pool_id); there is no evict_counter field or round-robin shard cycling (src/lib.rs:434-466). Also removed the stale 'Creusot P10' verified claim.
proposals.before: evict_next() cycles through shards via atomic counter (round-robin) (Verified: Creusot P10)
proposals.after: evict_next() delegates victim selection to the eviction policy (identify_next_to_evict(pool_id)), then removes that slot and frees its allocation; there is no shard round-robin counter (Verified: Implementation)

proposals.rationale: src/lib.rs:468-470 binds the key parameter as _key and calls evict_next(); it is a pure alias. With a single global pool there is no shard to target, so this is correct/intended behavior. Removed stale 'Creusot P4, P5' claim.
proposals.before: evict_next_for_key() evicts from the same shard as the target key (Verified: Creusot P4, P5)
proposals.after: evict_next_for_key(key) is an alias for evict_next(); the `key` argument is ignored because the pool is not sharded (Verified: Implementation)

proposals.rationale: oldest_keys makes a single ep.get_eviction_candidates(pool_id, n) call (src/lib.rs:424-432); there is no (n/NUM_SHARDS).max(1) per-shard sampling.
proposals.before: oldest_keys(n) peeks at N oldest keys across shards
proposals.after: oldest_keys(n) returns up to N oldest keys via a single `IEvictionPolicy::get_eviction_candidates(pool_id, n)` call (no per-shard sampling)

proposals.rationale: not_implemented in drift report ('16-way sharded allocator ... NFR-002'). Rewrote to describe the actual single-RwLock concurrency model.
proposals.after: A single `RwLock<Pool>` serializes mutations while allowing concurrent readers; data-path touches are applied outside the pool lock via the eviction policy's own synchronization

proposals.rationale: No proof artifacts exist under components/memory-tier/verif/ and no shards exist. Removed Success Criterion #8 ('10 formal properties verified with Creusot') and every 'Creusot P#' entry in the Verified column (FR-006/008/009/010/013/014/015/023). The interface-doc overclaiming (P4/P5/P10 'Verified') was already removed from components/interfaces/src/imemory_tier.rs; policy forbids re-adding it. A residual 'same shard as key' phrase remains in the interface's evict_next_for_key doc comment (out of this component's edit scope).
proposals.before: SC-8: '10 formal properties verified with Creusot (21 verification conditions)'; FR Verified column entries 'Creusot P1/P2/P3/P4/P5/P8/P9/P10'
proposals.after: SC-8 removed; Creusot annotations replaced with 'Unit test' or 'Implementation' as appropriate

proposals.requirement: not_implemented: 16-way sharded allocator and slot map (FR-005/006/007, NFR-002)
proposals.rationale: Never-built design. Resolved by the FR-005/FR-006/FR-007 and NFR-002 backfills above — spec no longer mandates the unbuilt shard structure.
proposals.before: (spec mandated a 16-way sharded allocator + per-shard slot maps)
proposals.after: (spec now describes the single RwLock<Pool> allocator + HashMap slot map as built)

proposals.rationale: Never-built. Resolved by the FR-013 backfill — spec no longer mandates an evict_counter/round-robin cycling.
proposals.before: (spec mandated an atomic round-robin shard counter for eviction)
proposals.after: (spec now states victim selection is delegated to the eviction policy)

proposals.rationale: Three-way version conflict with no authoritative value: Cargo.toml = 0.1.0, define_component! macro = 0.3.0 (src/lib.rs:140), spec = 0.2.0. Backfilling requires choosing a single real version, which means editing Cargo.toml and src/lib.rs (out of scope) — and none of the three is obviously correct. Left spec text unchanged pending a maintainer decision to reconcile all three.
